dsh-auto-continue 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

posts.en:
dsh-auto-continue is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-36d53d1c3fc4720d381b.html
